# Size Guide

Cairn & Co. outfitters (Bend, Oregon, est. 2014) publishes a single size guide covering outerwear, packs, footwear, and hosiery. The guide's core advice: **measure over a base layer**, and when between sizes, **size up for layering, down for a trimmer fit**.

## Jackets & Layers (Unisex Fit)

Measurements in chest, waist, and sleeve.

| Size | Chest (in) | Chest (cm) | Waist (in) | Sleeve (in) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| XS | 33–35 | 84–89 | 27–29 | 31.5 |
| S | 35–37 | 89–94 | 29–31 | 32.5 |
| M | 38–40 | 97–102 | 32–34 | 33.5 |
| L | 41–43 | 104–109 | 35–37 | 34.5 |
| XL | 44–46 | 112–117 | 38–40 | 35.5 |
| XXL | 47–50 | 119–127 | 41–44 | 36.5 |

**Fit notes by product**
- Default: regular fit with room for a fleece.
- Talus Down Hoodie: trim — size up to layer over a fleece.
- Cinder Insulated Parka: relaxed fit.
- Switchback Wind Shell: athletic fit.

## Backpacks: Torso Length

Packs fit by **torso length, not height**. Measure from the C7 vertebra (bony bump at the base of the neck) down the spine to the line between the tops of the hip bones — ideally with a helper.

| Pack | S | M | L |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cairn 45 Trekking Pack | 15–17 in | 17–19 in | 19–21 in |
| Long Haul Expedition Pack | Adjustable, fits 16–22 in torsos | — | — |
| Scree 28 Daypack | One size, fits 16–21 in torsos | — | — |

## Footwear

All footwear is listed in **US men's sizes**. Women should order **1.5 sizes down** from their usual women's size (e.g., a women's 9 corresponds to a men's 7.5).

- Ascent Mid boot: true to size.
- Scree Trail Runner: runs half a size small — size up half a size.

| US men's | US women's | UK | EU | Foot length (cm) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 7 | 8.5 | 6 | 40 | 25.0 |
| 8 | 9.5 | 7 | 41 | 26.0 |
| 9 | 10.5 | 8 | 42.5 | 27.0 |
| 10 | 11.5 | 9 | 44 | 28.0 |
| 11 | 12.5 | 10 | 45 | 29.0 |
| 12 | 13.5 | 11 | 46 | 30.0 |
| 13 | – | 12 | 47.5 | 31.0 |
